description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Leo)].

On a Zenith day the Lion gives you two extra actions each turn, usable only to Strike or Stride. The first is the quickened condition, which pf2e understands. This counter is the second.

pf2e keeps no pool of actions — the sheet has no number to decrement — so the count is here, on the token, and it goes back to 1 at the start of each of your turns. Click it down when you spend it.

rules.text: A second extra action this turn, Strike or Stride only, on top of quickened.
rules.title: Lightning Plasma (Zenith)
